# Career Feed v0.1.0

Career Feed v0.1.0 is the first public release for fork-based usage.

한국어 문서는 [KR Start](https://github.com/stdiodh/career-feed/blob/v0.1.0/docs/kr/README.md)에서 시작하세요.
English documentation starts at [EN Start](https://github.com/stdiodh/career-feed/blob/v0.1.0/docs/en/README.md).

## What Works

- Daily Backend Brief through GitHub Actions.
- Korea Dev/AI News Daily through GitHub Actions.
- Backend Career Site Radar through GitHub Actions.
- PS progress marking through manual workflow dispatch.
- Dry-run artifact review before Discord delivery.
- Validation before Discord delivery.
- Fork setup with GitHub Actions Secrets and Variables.

## Out of Scope

- Persistent server, database, hosted dashboard, Discord Gateway Bot, or Slash Command service.
- Automatic job applications, career matching, or final career advice.
- Automatic comments, pull requests, assignment, or label changes on external repositories.
- Guaranteed source availability, news accuracy, hiring accuracy, or OSS issue availability.

## Honest Usage Note

No stars, downloads, active users, or adoption metrics are claimed for this release.
Career Feed is presented as an early fork-ready OSS project that can be evaluated through its workflows, artifacts, validation rules, and documentation.
